representative_scale.policy: One fixed timing scale; no scale search, doubling, or toy extrapolation. Timeout if budget exceeded.

outputs.evaluator: Counts output files and verifies a private file digest; exact implementation and result schema unavailable.

timing_scope.streamed: Printed Total time (ms.) spans host preprocessing, H2D transfer, GPU pricing, D2H transfer and completion-event waits; excludes allocation/RNG initialization, CPU finalization, Black-Scholes checking and compilation.
timing_scope.threaded: Use published threaded Total time print and trusted wall; do not assume identical internal timing boundaries to streamed.
timing_scope.trusted_wall: Entire invocation wall seconds from comparison harness.

scoring_interface.anchors: Evaluate anchors.json on the published 8192-option one-GPU scale, using verdict/unrounded reserve at printed boundary; retain exit status.
scoring_interface.comparison: Execute both arms for p1 streamed, p2 threaded and p3 streamed with plant=hidden_link; extract reserve/l1 with comparison_view regexes; sealed metrics as declared. No published numerical agreement tolerance supplied.
scoring_interface.missing: No public evaluator code/pin, expected digest or exact invocation interface beyond named command.

budget_policy.setup_anchors_profile: Use remaining time before ceiling when args budgets absent. No runtime estimate established; do not search scales.
